name: abilene
description: Abilene / Internet2 US research backbone (11 nodes, 14 links), February 2005 snapshot. Second verified real topology, added to replace the unverified COST239 placeholder.
source: Internet Topology Zoo (https://github.com/mroughan/InternetTopologyZoo, gml/Abilene.gml), primary reference: Knight, Nguyen, Falkner, Bowden, Roughan, "The Internet Topology Zoo", IEEE JSAC 29(9), 2011; original data source cited in that file: Internet2, http://www.internet2.edu/pubs/200502-IS-AN.pdf. Node lat/lon are verbatim from that GML file; length_km below is the great-circle (haversine) distance between each edge's endpoints, computed from those coordinates (the GML file itself has no link-length attribute, only link type e.g. 'OC-192').
